paper_title: Recognizing Graphs Close to Bipartite Graphs
statement: As well as showing that the problem of recognizing near-bipartite graphs of diameter 3 is NP-complete, we have proven that for every integer ∆ ≥ 3, the Stable(D∆−2 ) problem is polynomial-time solvable on graphs of maximum degree ∆. Is Stable(D∆−2 ) NP-complete for graphs of maximum degree ∆ + 1? Recall that this is known to be the case for ∆ = 3, as proven by Yang and Yuan [29]. Their proof can easily be adapted to prove that Stable(D∆−2 ) is NP-complete for graphs of maximum degree 2∆ − 2 for every ∆ ≥ 4.
